messages:
lin: noticed parity bug: py raises requests.HTTPError('401'), js returns {error:'Unauthorized',message:'Invalid key'} — sample apps expect .status/.retry_after.

oscar: can we define canonical error JSON + SDK mapping? propose fields: error_type,status,message,retry_after,error_schema_version

maya: example payload:
{"error_type":"rate_limit","status":429,"message":"Too many requests","retry_after":8,"error_schema_version":"1.0"}

oscar: SDKs should expose typed exceptions: RateLimitError(status, retry_after, retryable=True), AuthError(status, retryable=False), BadRequestError(field_errors). include .raw (optional) and helper sdk.is_retryable(err).

lin: py plan: add Exception subclasses and keep HTTPError alias that wraps new ones with DeprecationWarning. add unit tests + sample quickstart showing exponential backoff using retry_after when present.

ops-bot: Draft PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/py-sdk/pull/420, https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/93

maya: edgecases: streaming endpoints — if error pre-stream, return canonical JSON; mid-stream, emit final error chunk with agreed marker. runtime owners need to opt-in to avoid breaking consumers.

oscar: mapping table in docs + short snippet for quickstarts. I'll own docs. tagging @eng-runtime for streaming behavior. lin: thanks — aiming for SDK sprint next week.
